Rashi on Chullin 75a:10:1.hebrew: דהושיט ידו כו' חדשים גרמי - וכיון דכלו לו חדשיו, חלבו אסור; ומיהו כי שחטה לאמו, שרי ליה רבי יהודה מ"כל בבהמה תאכלו":
Rashi on Chullin 75a:10:1.english: Where [one] inserted his hand, etc., [the] months cause [it] - And since its months [of gestation] were completed, its fat is forbidden; however, when one slaughters its mother, Rabbi Yehudah permits it from [the verse], "Any [animal] among the animals you may eat":

Rashi on Chullin 75a:11:1.hebrew: מה חלב ושתי הכליות כו' - בתורת כהנים שנויה: בשלמים — "את כל החלב אשר על הקרב", ולא את השליל. יכול לא יהא בעונש ואזהרה, אבל יהא בעמוד והקרב? כשהוא אומר "חלב ושתי הכליות" באשם, שאין ת"ל — דמה שלמים שאין כל מינן טעון אליה הרי הן טעונין חלב ושתי הכליות, אשם שכל מינו טעון אליה אינו דין שיטעון חלב ושתי הכליות, ומה תלמוד לומר? — אלא לומר לך: מה חלב ושתי הכליות האמור באשם מוצא מכלל שליל — חלב זה מוצא מכלל חלב שליל, שאינך יכול לומר חלב שליל יקריב הנמצא באשם, שהרי אין אשם נקבה:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:11:1.english: [Just as] the fat and the two kidneys, etc. - This [baraita] is taught in Torat Kohanim: Regarding peace offerings [it is written], "all the fat that is upon the innards" — and not [the fat of] a fetus. One might think that it is not subject to punishment and prohibition, yet it is subject to [the command,] "arise and offer [it]"? When [Scripture] states "the fat and the two kidneys" regarding a guilt offering, which is unnecessary to state — for if peace offerings, not all of whose species require [burning] the fat-tail, nevertheless require [burning] the fat and the two kidneys, then a guilt offering, all of whose species require [burning] the fat-tail, is it not logical that it should require [burning] the fat and the two kidneys, so why does Scripture state [it]? — rather, [it comes] to tell you: just as the fat and the two kidneys stated regarding a guilt offering are excluded from [applying to] a fetus — [meaning] this fat is excluded from [including] the fat of a fetus, for you cannot say that one should offer the fat of a fetus found in a guilt offering, since a guilt offering is never female:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:11:2.hebrew: אף כל - אפילו בקרבנות הבאין נקבה, חלב האמור בהן מוצא מכלל שליל:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:11:2.english: So too, every - Even in [the case of] offerings that are brought [as] a female, the fat stated regarding them is excluded from the category of a fetus:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:12:1.hebrew: בשלמא לדידי - דאמינא חדשים גרמי, איכא לאוקמא להא בבן תשעה חי, דכיון דבהמה הוא, אצטריך למעוטי:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:12:1.english: Granted, according to me - who says [that] the months [of gestation] cause [its status], this [exclusion] can be established as referring to a live nine-month [fetus], for since it is [considered] an animal, it was necessary [for a verse] to exclude it:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:12:2.hebrew: אלא לדידך - הא לאו חלב מיקרי, ופשיטא דאינו בעמוד והקרב, ולמה לי למעוטיה:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:12:2.english: But according to you - it is not called chelev [forbidden fat], and it is obvious that it is not [included] in "stand and offer [it on the altar]," so why do I need [a verse] to exclude it:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:12:3.english: My explanation - [namely,] that I say it is not forbidden fat:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:12:4.hebrew: מהכא - ילפינן ליה, דהכא אפקיה רחמנא מכלל חלב, דמעטיה מהקרבה; ואי לאו דמעטיה, הוי אמינא דחלב הוא:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:12:4.english: From here - we derive it, for here the Merciful One removed it from the category of forbidden fat, in that He excluded it from being offered [on the altar]; and were it not that He excluded it, I would have said that it is [considered] forbidden fat:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:14:1.hebrew: משום הכי מיעטיה - לאשמועינן דלאו חלב הוא, אלא לדידך דאמרת חלב הוא לענין אכילה, אמאי מיעטיה מהקרבה:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:14:1.english: Due to that reason, [the Merciful One] excluded it - to teach us that it is not [considered] chelev [forbidden fat]; rather, according to you, who say that it is chelev with respect to eating, why did [the Merciful One] exclude it from being offered [as a sacrifice]?

Rashi on Chullin 75a:14:2.hebrew: מידי דהוה אמחוסר זמן - דיצא לאויר וכלו חדשיו, ודכולי עלמא בהמה הוא, ופסליה רחמנא בהקרבה כל שבעה:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:14:2.english: Just as it is with [an animal] whose time has not yet [arrived] - [For] it has emerged into the air [of the world] and its [gestation] months are complete, and according to everyone it is [considered] an animal, yet the Merciful One disqualified it from being offered [as a sacrifice] all seven [days]:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:15:1.english: According to the one who prohibits - a live nine-[month]-old [fetus] in a kosher [animal] until one slaughters it:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:15:2.hebrew: מתיר - את זה באכילה, דשחיטתו מטהרתו:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:15:2.english: He permits - this [fetus] for consumption, since its [own] slaughter renders it pure [and permitted]:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:15:3.english: According to the statement of the one who permits [it] - without slaughter in [the case of] a kosher [animal]:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:15:4.hebrew: אוסר - בשל טרפה, דשחיטה דידיה לא מהניא ביה, ובשחיטת הטרפה לא מישתרי, שהרי הוא כאחד מאיבריה:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:15:4.english: He prohibits - in [the case of] a tereifa, for its own slaughter does not avail it, and through the slaughter of the tereifa it is not permitted, since it is like one of its limbs:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:16:1.hebrew: ארבעה סימנין - היתרא הוא דרבי ביה רחמנא מ"כל בבהמה תאכלו", שאם רצה אוכלו בשחיטת אמו, אבל אם צריך הוא לשחיטת עצמו — כגון שליל של טרפה — שוחטו ומותר, שהוא ניתר בב' מד' סימנין: או בושט וקנה שלו, או בושט וקנה של אמו: בין בדרבי אמי, ובין בדרב חסדא, ובין ב"תני רבי חייא" — בכולהו גרסינן "השוחט את הטרפה", ובתוספתא דר' חייא נמצא כן:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:16:1.english: Four simanim - It is a permission that the Merciful One included from [the verse] "anything among the animals you may eat," that if one wishes, he may eat it [the fetus] through the slaughter of its mother, but if it requires its own slaughter — such as the fetus of a tereifa — he slaughters it and it is permitted, for it is rendered permitted by two of four simanim: either by its own esophagus and trachea, or by the esophagus and trachea of its mother. Whether in [the statement of] Rabbi Ami, or in [the statement of] Rav Chisda, or in [the baraita] "Rabbi Chiya taught" — in all of them we read [the text]: "One who slaughters a tereifa," and in the Tosefta of Rabbi Chiya it is found thus:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:1:1.hebrew: בשחיטה יבישתא - עסקינן שלא יצא ממנה דם, שאף אמו לא הוכשרה, ולהאי תנא שחיטה בלא דם לא מכשרה, ודלא כרבי שמעון:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:1:1.english: With a dry slaughter - [We] are dealing [with a case] where no blood came out from it, for even its mother was not rendered susceptible [to ritual impurity], and according to this Tanna, slaughter without blood does not render [meat] susceptible [to ritual impurity], and [this is] not in accordance with Rabbi Shimon:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:2:1.hebrew: מאן תנא - דמטמי ליה אע"פ שהוא חי:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:2:1.english: Who taught - [i.e.,] who declares it [capable of becoming] impure even though it is alive:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:2:2.hebrew: מטמא טומאת אוכלין - בן פקועה, ואפילו חי, אם נגע בטומאה:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:2:2.english: Contracts food impurity - [that is,] a ben pekua, even [while] alive, if it touched impurity:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:2:3.hebrew: וצריך הכשר - דתרי גופי נינהו. אלמא לר' יוסי הגלילי מטמא מחיים, וכרבנן דמתניתין לא אוקמה ונימא לדידהו כבשרא בדיקולא דמיא; דקסבר רבי יוחנן: אפילו רבנן דפליגי אדרבי יוסי הגלילי בטומאה, סבירא להו כרבנן דמתניתין בשחיטה, ואפילו הכי לא מטמא מפני שהוא חי, ולאו בפלוגתא דרבי מאיר ורבנן דמתניתין קמיפלגי:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:2:3.english: And it needs to be rendered susceptible [to impurity] - Because they [the mother and the fetus] are two [separate] bodies. Thus, according to Rabbi Yosei HaGelili, it contracts impurity while alive. And [Rabbi Yochanan] did not establish [the baraita] in accordance with the Rabbis of our Mishnah — so as to say that according to them it is like meat in a basket — because Rabbi Yochanan holds [that] even the Rabbis who disagree with Rabbi Yosei HaGelili regarding impurity agree with the Rabbis of our Mishnah regarding slaughter, and even so it does not contract impurity because it is alive; and they are not arguing over the [same] dispute as Rabbi Meir and the Rabbis of our Mishnah:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:3:1.hebrew: ואזדא רבי יוחנן לטעמיה - מדקאמר רבי יוחנן: רבי יוסי הגלילי ובית שמאי, המטמאין דגים מחיים, אמרו דבר אחד — שמע מינה: רבנן דמטהרי בבן פקועה, לאו משום דס"ל דטעון שחיטה כר"מ; דאי טעמייהו משום דטעון שחיטה הוא, אינהו נמי, בדגים דלאו טעונין שחיטה, מודו דמטמו כב"ש; והיכי משמע דרבי יוסי הגלילי ודב"ש חדא:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:3:1.english: And Rabbi Yochanan follows his [own] reasoning - Since Rabbi Yochanan said [that] Rabbi Yosei HaGelili and Beit Shammai — who render fish impure while alive — said the same thing, learn from this [that] the Rabbis who declare a ben pekua pure [do] not [do so] because they hold that it requires slaughter like Rabbi Meir; for if their reason were that it requires slaughter, they too would agree regarding fish, which do not require slaughter, that they become impure [while alive] like Beit Shammai. And how is it implied that [the view of] Rabbi Yosei HaGelili and [that of] Beit Shammai are one [and the same]?

Rashi on Chullin 75a:4:1.hebrew: משיצודו - דכיון דאין טעונין שחיטה, הרי הן כמתים:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:4:1.english: From when they are caught - For since they do not require slaughter, they are [considered] as dead:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:5:1.hebrew: מקרטע - מפרפר, וכגון שיבש בו כסלע ובין סנפיריו, דתו לא חי, כדאמרינן במסכת שבת (דף קז:):
Rashi on Chullin 75a:5:1.english: Convulsing - Flopping about; and [this is in a case] where [an area] the size of a sela [coin] and between its fins has dried out, so that it can no longer live, as we say in Tractate Shabbat (107b):

Rashi on Chullin 75a:6:1.english: Symptoms of a tereifa developed in fish - For example, [where] their intestines were perforated, according to Rabbi Akiva:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:6:2.english: What is [the law] - that they become ritually impure:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:7:1.hebrew: אבל דגים דאין במינן - טרפות, לא הוי טרפות לגבייהו כמיתה:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:7:1.english: But [with regard to] fish, in whose species there is no - tereifut, tereifut is not [considered] like death for them:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:8:1.english: [If an animal] expelled a non-viable newborn - [This refers to] an animal that miscarries:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:8:2.english: Its fat is like the fat of a domesticated animal - [punishable] by karet:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:8:3.hebrew: כחלב חיה - ואין בו אלא איסור נבלה, שאין שחיטתו מטהרתו, אבל חלבו כבשרו:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:8:3.english: Like the fat of an undomesticated animal - And it has only the prohibition of an unslaughtered carcass [nevelah], since its slaughter does not purify it, but its fat is like its meat:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:9:1.hebrew: אוירא גרים - לשוייה בהמה, וכיון דנולד מיתסר, ואפי' לרבי יהודה דאמר לעיל (חולין דף עד.) חלבו מותר — התם הוא דלא יצא לאויר:
Rashi on Chullin 75a:9:1.english: Airspace causes - to render [it] a domesticated animal, and once it is born, it [i.e., its fat] is forbidden; and even according to Rabbi Yehudah, who said above (Chullin 74a) [that] its fat is permitted — that is [only] there, where it did not emerge into the airspace:

Rashi on Chullin 75a:9:2.english: Its fat is like the fat of an undomesticated animal; months [of gestation] also cause [it] - for we require [both] months and airspace:

Tosafot on Chullin 75a:11:1.hebrew: מה חלב ושתי כליות - ואם תאמר: מאי קאמר בת"כ שהביא בקונטרס, "יכול לא יהא בעונש ואזהרה, אבל יהא בעמוד והקרב"? והא ההוא קרא ד"החלב אשר על הקרב", דממעט מיניה שליל, לענין הקרבה כתיב! וי"ל: דהא דקאמר בת"כ "ולא חלב שליל", לאו משום דלימעוט מההוא קרא, אלא משום דמשתרי מן "כל בבהמה", ואין חשוב חלב; ובתר הכי קאמר, דדלמא אע"ג דנפקא לן מ"כל בבהמה" דאינו בעונש ואזהרה, מ"מ הוי בעמוד והקרב:
Tosafot on Chullin 75a:11:1.english: Just [as with regard to] the fat and two kidneys - And if you ask: What does [the baraita] mean in Torat Kohanim, which [was] cited in the Kunteres [Rashi], "One might [think] it is not subject to punishment and prohibition, but it is subject to 'arise and offer [it]'"? After all, that verse of "the fat that is upon the innards," from which a fetus is excluded, is written with regard to offering [a sacrifice]! And one can say: That which it says in Torat Kohanim, "and not the fat of a fetus," is not because it is excluded from that verse, rather because it is permitted [for consumption] from [the verse] "anything among the animals," and it is [therefore] not considered chelev [forbidden fat]; and afterwards it says that perhaps, even though we derive from "anything among the animals" that it is not subject to punishment and prohibition, nevertheless it is subject to "arise and offer [it]":

Tosafot on Chullin 75a:15:1.hebrew: לדברי המתיר אוסר - והא דתנן "קרעה טעון שחיטה", אתיא אפילו לדברי המתיר; דהכא דוקא לדברי המתיר אסור, דמהני שחיטת טרפה לענין טומאה, והוי כחציו שחוט, ותו לא מהניא ביה שחיטה, אבל התם לא נשחטה אמו כלל. וכן הא דאמרינן לעיל (חולין דף עד.) גבי בעיא ד"הושיט ידו למעי בהמה ושחט בה בן ט' חי, מהו, או דילמא אפילו לרבנן ד' סימנין אכשר ביה רחמנא" — לא דמי להא דאסרינן הכא לרבנן, משום דהכא כחציו שחוט כדפרישית. ואפילו לרבא, דאמר הכא "ד' סימנין אכשר ביה רחמנא", איכא למיבעי לעיל, דדילמא שאני התם דלא יצא לאויר העולם, ואסור אפילו לרבי מאיר. וה"נ בין לרבי יוחנן בין לר"ל דפליגי בתלש חלב מבן ט' חי, מיתוקמא ההיא בעיא לעיל; דאפילו לרבי יוחנן דאמר חדשים גרמי, היינו לחלב שנתלש ויצא לאויר העולם, ואין איסור חלב חל עד שיולד, כדמוכח בפ' גיד הנשה (לקמן חולין דף קג.) ובסוף פ' דם שחיטה (כריתות דף כג:); ואפי' לר"ל דאמר חדשים ואוירא גרמי, אפשר דבמעי אמו מהני ביה שחיטה, כי היכי דמהניא ליה שחיטת אמו:
Tosafot on Chullin 75a:15:1.english: According to the statement of the one who permits, he prohibits - And that which we learned in the Mishnah, "If one tore her open, it requires slaughter," accords even with the view of the one who permits [here]; for here specifically, according to the one who permits, it is prohibited because the slaughter of a tereifa is effective with respect to [preventing] ritual impurity [of carrion], so it is like [an animal that is] half-slaughtered, and slaughter is no longer effective for it; whereas there [where he tore her open], its mother was not slaughtered at all. And similarly, that which [the Gemara] says above (Chullin 74a) regarding the dilemma: "If one reached his hand into the womb of an animal and slaughtered inside it a live nine-[month]-old [fetus], what is [the law]? Or perhaps even according to the Rabbis, the Merciful One rendered four simanim valid for it?" — [that case] is not comparable to this [case] where we prohibit [it] here according to the Rabbis, because here it is like [an animal that is] half-slaughtered, as I have explained. And even according to Rava, who says here, "The Merciful One rendered four simanim valid for it," there is [still room] to raise the dilemma above, for perhaps it is different there because it has not emerged into the air of the world, and [therefore] it is prohibited even according to Rabbi Meir. And so too, both according to Rabbi Yochanan and according to Reish Lakish, who disagree regarding one who detached chelev from a live nine-[month]-old [fetus], that dilemma above can be established: for even according to Rabbi Yochanan, who says [that the] months [of gestation] cause [the prohibition of chelev to apply], that applies [only] to chelev that was detached and emerged into the air of the world, and the prohibition of chelev does not take effect until it is born, as is proven in the chapter [entitled] Gid HaNasheh (below, Chullin 103a) and at the end of the chapter [entitled] Dam Shechitah (Keritot 23b); and even according to Reish Lakish, who says [that both the] months [of gestation] and [emerging into] the air cause [it], it is possible that inside its mother's womb slaughter is effective for it, just as its mother's slaughter is effective for it:

Tosafot on Chullin 75a:5:1.hebrew: מאי בינייהו דג מקרטע - לאו בין רבי עקיבא וב"ה קא בעי, דמחלוקתן מפורש בהדיא דלב"ה דוקא משימותו; אלא בין בית שמאי לרבי עקיבא קאמר, דתרוייהו מחיים מטמו, ומפרש דאיכא בינייהו דג מקרטע. פירוש: שקופץ ומדלג בחוזק, דלבית שמאי טמא, ולרבי עקיבא טהור, כיון דאם זורקו במים הוא יכול לחיות. ומקרטע לשון כח וחיות גדול, כמו שהביא בערוך, מדאמר בילמדנו בפרשת בהעלותך: "וכיון שהוא יוצא ורואה את הנר, מיד הוא מתחיל שמח ועומד ומקרטע לפניו". "תדוץ דאבה" (איוב מא) מתרגמינן: "קדמיה מקרטע":
Tosafot on Chullin 75a:5:1.english: What is [the difference] between them? A convulsing fish - [The Gemara] is not asking [what the difference is] between Rabbi Akiva and Beit Hillel, for their dispute is stated explicitly, that according to Beit Hillel [it is] only once they die; rather, it is speaking of [the difference] between Beit Shammai and Rabbi Akiva, for both of them [hold that] they contract impurity while alive, and [the Gemara] explains that the difference between them is a convulsing fish. Meaning: [a fish] that leaps and jumps vigorously, which according to Beit Shammai is impure, and according to Rabbi Akiva is pure, since if one throws it into the water it can live. And *mekarte'a* ("convulsing") is an expression of great strength and vitality, as [is] brought in the Arukh, from what is stated in [Midrash] Yelammedenu in Parashat Beha'alotkha: "And as soon as he comes out and sees the candle, he immediately begins to rejoice, and stands and leaps (*mekarte'a*) before him." "[And] dismay danceth" (Job 41[:14]) we translate [in the Targum] as: "leaps (*mekarte'a*) before him":

Tosafot on Chullin 75a:9:1.hebrew: רבי יוחנן אמר חלבו כחלב בהמה - והא דשרי רבי יהודה לעיל חלבו של בן תשעה חי, ה"מ לאחר שחיטה, דניתר בשחיטת אמו:
Tosafot on Chullin 75a:9:1.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Its fat is like the fat of a domesticated animal - And as for that which Rabbi Yehuda permitted above the fat of a live nine-month [fetus] — that applies only after [its mother's] slaughter, for it is permitted through the slaughter of its mother:
